---
name: Fatigue method implementation or validation
about: Propose a scoped implementation, source check, repair or validation task
---

## Catalogue identity and status

Permanent ID, standard name/aliases, primary/secondary family, implementation and independent validation status. Search existing Issues first.

## Catalogue and roadmap relationship

Is this already in the complete catalogue? State aliases/related versions, whether selected or off-roadmap, and why it adds a useful distinct capability. Off-roadmap proposals are welcome; an unresolved bundle needs source/scope clarification first.

## Primary reference

Authors/year, exact title, source, DOI or traceable no-DOI reference, version/erratum and verification status. Do not attach copyrighted papers without permission.

## Scientific scope

Principle; CA P/NP/mean-stress applicability; material restrictions; inputs/units; output (limit/DP/life/probability). Distinguish original formulation and proposed repository adaptations.

## Existing code, tests and dependencies

Relevant paths/symbols, reusable components, missing functionality/data, catalogue entry and related Issues.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exact source/version and complete governing components specified.
- [ ] Required inputs and mathematical/numerical procedures supported within bounded scope.
- [ ] Analytical/degenerate/phase/frame checks and convergence where relevant.
- [ ] Independent worked published example or explicit remaining validation gap.
- [ ] Regression suite passes; unrelated behavior preserved.
- [ ] Catalogue, evidence links and generated docs updated; completeness and validation reviewed independently.
